dialogues.speaker: Charlotte
dialogues.text: Whoa, this is giving me deja vu... Takes me right back to when I was a rookie journalist, scouring the streets for potential news stories.

dialogues.speaker: Charlotte
dialogues.text: Where you get a lot of people gathered in one place, information starts to circulate. It's out of that environment that news is born. So we're not likely to stumble across any big stories today, with only you and me here.

dialogues.speaker: Charlotte
dialogues.text: But that aside — if you're looking to stock up that newsstand, I recommend The Steambird.
